quotes.message: Practice makes perfect.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.message: Wisdom is not a product of schooling but of the lifelong attempt to acquire it.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.message: You don’t understand anything until you learn it more than one way.
quotes.author: Marvin Minsky

quotes.message: Spoon feeding in the long run teaches us nothing but the shape of the spoon.
quotes.author: E. M. Forster

quotes.message: Anyone who stops learning is old, whether at twenty or eighty. Anyone who keeps learning stays young.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.message: In the end we retain from our studies only that which we practically apply.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang Von Goethe

quotes.message: The beautiful thing about learning is nobody can take it away from you.
quotes.author: B.B. King

quotes.message: Being a student is easy. Learning requires actual work.
quotes.author: William Crawford

quotes.message: Study without desire spoils the memory, and it retains nothing that it takes in.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.message: A man who asks is a fool for five minutes. A man who never asks is a fool for life.
quotes.author: Chinese Proverb

quotes.message: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.message: Leadership and learning are indispensable to each other.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.message: If you are willing to learn, no one can help you. If you are determined to learn, no one can stop you.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.message: The expert in anything was once a beginner.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.message: Learn continually. There’s always ‘one more thing’ to learn!
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.message: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.message: I am always ready to learn although I do not always like being taught.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.message: Develop a passion for learning. If you do, you will never cease to grow.
quotes.author: Anthony J. D’Angelo

quotes.message: Change is the end result of all true learning.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.message: If you think education is expensive, try estimating the cost of ignorance.
quotes.author: Howard Gardner

quotes.message: I am still learning.
quotes.author: Michelangelo (age 87)

quotes.message: He who learns but does not think, is lost! He who thinks but does not learn is in great danger.
quotes.author: Confucius
